title: Path Following with Coaxial-Rotor MAV in the Presence of Wind Gusts
content: This work presents a nonlinear aerodynamic model that describes the dynamics 1 of a coaxial-rotor MAV. We have designed seven control laws based on linear and nonlinear 2 controllers for path following with a coaxial-rotor MAV in the presence of unknown 3 disturbances, such as wind gusts. The linear controllers are the Proportional-Derivative (PD) 4 and the Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID). The nonlinear techniques are the nested 5 saturation, sliding mode control, second-order sliding mode, high-order sliding mode, and 6 adaptive backstepping. The results are presented after several computer simulations.
